CIVIL JUDGE AND JMFC AND COMMISSIONER FOR WORKMEN'S COMPENSATION AT RAICHUR, EXONERATING THE LIABILITY OF THE APPELLANT TO PAY THE COMPENSATION AND ETC.,
 THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR HEARING ON I.A, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT
Challenging judgment and award dated 15.10.2019 passed by II Addl.
Senior Civil Judge and JMFC and Commissioner for Workmen's Compensation, Raichur (for short 'Commissioner') in ECA No.308/2014, this appeal is filed.
2. Sri Mohd. Abdul Quayum, learned counsel for appellant submitted that appeal was by insurer challenging award on ground of same being passed without necessary findings.

It was submitted that Commissioner passed award as if claim petition was under Motor Vehicles Act NC:
2023:KHC-K:8217 and without giving specific finding regarding quantum of loss of earning capacity, determined compensation.
Thus, impugned order passed was without giving necessary findings would be contrary to provisions of Employee's Compensation Act and sought for allowing appeal.
3. On other hand, Sri Basavaraj R.Math, learned counsel for respondents sought to justify award.

4. From above submission, substantial question of law that would arise for consideration is :
"Whether impugned order passed by Commissioner is contrary to Employee's Compensation Act ?"

sentences.text: Admittedly this is a claim petition filed under provision of Employee's Compensation Act.

It is settled law that while passing award, Commissioner is required to give specific finding regarding relationship of 'employer and employee', occurrence of accident 'in course of and out of employment'.

For purposes of assessment of compensation under Section 4 of Workmen's NC:
2023:KHC-K:8217 Compensation Act

, Commissioner was required to determine age, occupation,
income and extent of disability of workman and assess compensation.
But in instant case, there is absolutely no discussion about disability sustained.
Hence, impugned order would be perverse and required to be set-aside.
As such, substantial question of law is answered in affirmative.

Consequently, following :
ORDER (i) Appeal is allowed.
(ii) Impugned order dated 15.10.2019 passed by II Addl. Senior Civil Judge and JMFC and Commissioner for Workmen's Compensation, Raichur in E.C.A.No.308/2014 is set-aside.
(iii) Matter remanded back to Commissioner for passing fresh order in accordance with law and taking note of observations made herein above.
(iv) To enable early disposal and since both insurer and claimant are represented they are directed to appear before Commissioner NC: 2023:KHC-K:8217 on 22.11.2023, without awaiting fresh notice.
(v) Thereafter Commissioner shall hear both parties and pass fresh order within an outer limit of two months by giving findings on all necessary issues.
(vi) In view of disposal appeal, IA no.2/2021 is rendered unnecessary and dismissed.
